episode: Kanto #001 · V3 — chỉ những ảnh CHƯA CÓ
_note: Bộ này chỉ gồm ảnh V3 cần mà kho kanto-001 chưa có. Cùng outDir nên import về là trộn chung. Ảnh đã có thì dùng lại, đừng sinh lại — sinh lại ra ảnh khác là hỏng toạ độ callout đã đo.

extraCreatures.fearow: Fearow, a large brown bird-like creature with a very long thin beak, a red crest and broad wings, fierce eyes
extraCreatures.zooxanthellae: a living reef coral polyp colony seen very close, translucent tissue with tiny golden-brown symbiotic algae cells visible inside the polyp flesh
extraCreatures.lichen: a crustose and foliose lichen growing on a damp granite boulder, pale sage-green and grey lobes with fine black apothecia
extraCreatures.mistletoe: a clump of mistletoe growing out of the trunk of a dying host tree, its haustorium swelling where it enters the bark, host branches above it bare and dead
extraCreatures.basking-lizard: a wild rock lizard flattened against warm sunlit stone, body pressed wide to catch heat, throat pulsing
extraCreatures.agave: a century plant at the end of its life, one enormous flowering stalk shot straight up from a rosette of thick grey-green leaves, the rosette below already collapsing and browning
extraCreatures.sunflower: a young sunflower bud on its stem, head turned toward the sun, stem visibly curved from following it

shots.scene: side view of the whole animal, the vascular bundle that feeds the back bulb glowing brighter than the rest of the body, tracing from the base of the bulb down into the trunk and the gut cavity, the storage chamber inside the bulb clearly fuller than the stomach below it
shots.framing: full body profile, centred, even study lighting, generous empty space above and to the right for annotation

shots.scene: same study plate but the storage chamber inside the bulb is nearly empty and dim, only a faint residue of light left in it, while the limb and trunk conduits still glow, showing a reserve that has just been spent
shots.framing: full body profile, centred, matching the earlier study plate exactly so the two can be compared side by side

shots.scene: tight close-up of the back of the animal from slightly above and behind, the bulb clearly growing tilted over to one side instead of straight up, the base of the bulb where it meets the skin visible and slightly puckered on the compressed side
shots.framing: close on the bulb and upper back only, head out of focus at the frame edge, soft overcast light, shallow depth of field

shots.scene: close-up of the flank of a larger adult of the same species, a healed tear in the hide running along the ribs, the skin around it thickened and paler than the rest, old and long since closed
shots.framing: close on the flank, animal lying down, late afternoon side light raking across the scar

shots.scene: close-up of the head of an old large bird, one eye covered by a pale grey opaque film from an old injury, the other eye clear and alert, beak turned slightly toward camera
shots.framing: head and shoulders only, overcast sky behind, cold flat light

shots.scene: the animal pressed flat against damp leaf litter under a fern canopy, its dark dappled markings falling exactly on the patches of broken sunlight coming through the leaves above, so the body reads as ground rather than as an animal
shots.framing: from above and slightly to the side, the dappled light pattern filling the whole frame, the animal only resolving on a second look

shots.scene: several of the animals sleeping in a clearing at night, spaced evenly apart, none touching, one gap in the ring noticeably empty where another animal usually lies
shots.framing: wide, from slightly above, moonlight only, cool blue, long shadows

shots.scene: extreme close-up of living coral polyp tissue, the golden-brown symbiotic algae cells visible suspended inside the translucent flesh of the host
shots.framing: macro, shallow depth of field, clear blue water above

shots.scene: a lichen spread across damp granite, so completely merged that the fungal and algal parts cannot be told apart by eye
shots.framing: close, flat overcast light, shallow depth of field

shots.scene: a mistletoe clump thriving green on the trunk of its host, the branches of the host above it bare, grey and dead
shots.framing: medium, looking up the trunk, winter light

shots.scene: a lizard flattened wide against hot sunlit rock, absolutely still, warming before it can move fast
shots.framing: low and close, hard midday light, heat shimmer at the edge of frame

shots.scene: a century plant that has spent everything on one enormous flowering stalk, the rosette at its base already collapsing and browning
shots.framing: wide and low, the stalk running the full height of the frame, dry blue sky

shots.scene: a young sunflower bud with its stem visibly bent from turning to follow the sun through the day
shots.framing: close on the bud and upper stem, backlit, early morning

shots.scene: a first-day page: one quick pencil study of the whole animal lying down, drawn fast and unfinished, with a smaller thumbnail of its head in a corner
shots.framing: pages flat to camera

shots.scene: a hand drawn map of a forest clearing in pencil and ink, the treeline and a trail marked, and seven small empty circles scattered across the open ground with no writing beside them
shots.framing: pages flat to camera

shots.scene: a page with one careful ink study of the animal seen from the side, drawn in cross section so the gut cavity and the base of the back bulb are both visible on the same drawing
shots.framing: pages flat to camera

shots.scene: a page where a large block of the drawing area has been struck through with two decisive diagonal pencil strokes, the study of the animal underneath still visible through the strikethrough, and clean unused paper below it
shots.framing: pages flat to camera

shots.scene: a bookkeeping page: a hand ruled ink table with two tall empty columns and a heavy horizontal rule across the middle, no figures entered, a small pencil sketch of a plant bulb in the top corner
shots.framing: pages flat to camera

shots.scene: a page with a small ink drawing of a mechanical stopwatch and, beside it, two hand ruled empty columns for recording pairs of times, with a rough pencil sketch of the same trail drawn twice
shots.framing: pages flat to camera

shots.scene: a page written in obvious haste at night, the pencil pressure heavy and uneven, with a single hurried sketch of the animal standing alone among others in a hollow, the paper slightly cockled from damp
shots.framing: pages flat to camera

shots.scene: the final page of a long field notebook, one last careful ink study of a very old large adult of the species, moss and small ferns drawn growing on its back, and a great deal of clean unused paper left below the drawing
shots.framing: pages flat to camera
